scope: At p outside S0, m is a unit. For negative odd k=v_p(B), v_p(A)=k and v_p(H)=3k, so exactly one curve parameter has even valuation. Square scaling makes it a unit while both abscissas remain of odd valuation. The cubic valuation is then odd, contradicting a square. This proves only the stated one-sided obstruction.

The finite Kummer dimension gives r+t+dim F[2]=1. Conditional on the stated nondegenerate alternating pairing of the finite quotient, its primary cyclic factors pair, so dim F[2] is even. Thus F=0 and r+t=1. No nondegeneracy of the restricted pairing on F[2], or finiteness of the whole Sha, is assumed.
